gross_net_mislabel_not_reached_by_R167.what_it_is: A filing that prints its gross and net triangles with the same underwriting years, units and shape, where neither captured block carries a basis heading. The grid-wide rule then labels them from whatever basis words happen to appear elsewhere on the grid, and can get both backwards. R167 does not reach this: it reads the heading above the captured block, and there is none.
gross_net_mislabel_not_reached_by_R167.the_discriminator: Gross incurred claims cannot be smaller than net incurred claims. Where two triangles share years, units and shape, the one whose cells are smaller in MAGNITUDE is the net one. Magnitude, because a filing may present the triangle as an outflow, and there the gross figure is the more negative one.
